subject: y-axis rug marks scale with window width

messages.author: 3a775dfa0a96bf95
messages.subject: y-axis rug marks scale with window width
parts:
Make a simple rug plot:

qplot(1:10,1:10) + geom_rug()

Now change the aspect ratio of the display window so that it is much
wider than it is tall. The y-axis rugmarks stretch proportionately to
the window width; same thing if you make it much taller than wide for
the x-axis rug marks.

I'd think you'd want the x and y rugmarks to be the same size.

By the way, is there a way to display marginal density plots along the
x and y axes?

-s

>     qplot(1:10,1:10) + geom_rug()
>
> Now change the aspect ratio of the display window so that it is much
> wider than it is tall.  The y-axis rugmarks stretch proportionately to
> the window width; same thing if you make it much taller than wide for
> the x-axis rug marks.
>
> I'd think you'd want the x and y rugmarks to be the same size.

Yes, you probably would, but that would be adjusting the space between
the data and the plot boundaries in a way that depends on the
size/aspect ratio of the plot, which is not currently possible.

> By the way, is there a way to display marginal density plots along the
> x and y axes?

No, not easily. The only way I can think of would be to use viewports
and multiple plots.
